services.heading: What we do
services.lead: We take on the complete electrical package: containment, cabling, panels, lighting, earthing and critical power. We coordinate it in Revit, install it to written method statements and test it with our own commissioning team before handover.

scope.title: Containment
scope.text: Conduit in slabs, walls and floors; sleeves and back boxes; GI cable trays, ladders, trunking and raceways.

scope.title: Wiring & cabling
scope.text: Power and lighting wiring, DB-to-equipment wiring, HT/LT cable laying, dressing, tagging, glanding and termination.

scope.title: Panels & distribution
scope.text: LT panels and capacitor banks, MDBs, SMDBs and DBs, control wiring and panel earthing.

scope.title: Busducts & rising mains
scope.text: Busbar trunking and rising mains, supplied through OEM channels and installed to approved GA drawings.

scope.title: Lighting & accessories
scope.text: LED fixtures, lighting management systems, switches and sockets, fans and junction boxes.

scope.title: Critical power
scope.text: UPS and battery installation, server-room electrical works, AC unit connections, pumps and motors.

scope.title: Earthing & protection
scope.text: Earth pits and grids, GI and copper strip, surge protection devices and lightning arresters.

scope.title: Testing & maintenance
scope.text: Megger, IR and continuity tests, panel load tests, circuit verification and HT/LT equipment testing. Annual maintenance contracts (AMC).

deliver.insight: Electrical packages rarely slip on site.
deliver.insight_em: They slip waiting on approvals and long-lead equipment, so that is where we start.
deliver.panel2_note: Order placement, submittals and approvals for each are closed on a fixed timeline.

safety_rows.text: An emergency response team on call 24/7.
Project safety reviews every alternate day, and a weekly safety report reviewed by top management.
HIRA risk assessments, height and hot-work permits, and lock-out tag-out before live connections.
Toolbox talks, PPE for every worker, monthly medical camps and tie-ups with local hospitals.
